resources.string: Current item removed. Playback is paused.
The limit includes the current completion. In single-track repeat, reaching it advances to the next queue item. With the limit off, single-track repeat continues until you choose another item.
Enter a position within this queue.
The queue or current item changed. Cancel and reload before editing again.
Choose a position in the complete queue. Saving keeps the current song and playback position.
Choose a position in the saved shuffle order. The original order is kept for when shuffle is turned off.
This is the last item in playback order. Playback will stop; the remaining queue stays saved.
The next available item will be selected and remain paused.
This is the only queue item. Removing it leaves an empty, stopped queue.
Remove this exact queue instance. The audio file, music library and playlists are kept.
Turning shuffle on saves a new complete order with the current item first. Turning it off restores the original order. Saving an unchanged mode keeps the existing order.
